2607.06974.title: MILES: Modular Instruction Memory with Learnable Selection for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
2607.06974.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly improve their reasoning at test time via additional computation, yet most existing works treat each problem in isolation. When problems arrive sequentially, accumulating reusable experience across them can further improve performance. Existing memory-based methods either store whole-solution templates that generalize poorly to novel problems or use heuristic step-level selection that is not optimized for final-answer correctness. Learning selection policies requires large-scale training data and fixed action spaces, making such approaches unsuitable for test-time settings where memory expands incrementally and only limited supervision is available. We propose MILES (Modular Instruction Memory with LEarnable Selection for self-improving LLM reasoning), a framework that dynamically expands step-wise memory and applies correctness-optimized memory composition under realistic test-time constraints. MILES maintains modular memory units consisting of asymmetric pairs of sub-goal embeddings and sub-instructions, each associated with a learnable selection head. This memory structure enables a coarse-to-fine retrieval mechanism: The coarse level enables memory expansion and collects supervision for training selection heads from confident samples, while the fine stage applies learned selection heads to rerank coarse-level candidates and guide reasoning for uncertain samples. MILES consistently matches or outperforms prior methods while achieving superior accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness, robustness, and transferability.
2607.06974.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在測試時通過額外的計算不斷改善其推理能力，但大多數現有的研究將每個問題視為孤立的個體。當問題依次出現時，積累可重用的經驗可以進一步提高性能。現有的基於記憶的方法要麼存儲整體解決方案模板，這些模板對新問題的泛化效果不佳，要麼使用步驟級的啟發式選擇，這些選擇並未針對最終答案的正確性進行優化。學習選擇策略需要大規模的訓練數據和固定的動作空間，這使得這些方法不適合在測試時的環境中使用，因為在這種環境下記憶是逐步擴展的，並且只有有限的監督可用。我們提出了MILES（模塊化指令記憶與可學習選擇，用於自我改進的LLM推理），這是一個在現實的測試時間約束下，動態擴展逐步記憶並應用針對正確性的優化記憶組合的框架。MILES維持由不對稱的子目標嵌入和子指令組成的模塊化記憶單元，每個單元都與一個可學習的選擇頭相關聯。這種記憶結構使得粗到細的檢索機制成為可能：粗層級允許記憶擴展並從自信的樣本中收集監督以訓練選擇頭，而細層級則應用學習到的選擇頭對粗層級候選進行重新排序，並指導不確定樣本的推理。MILES始終能夠與先前的方法相匹配或超越，同時實現更優的準確性與效率的權衡。大量實驗證明了其有效性、穩健性和可轉移性。
